# Vendored: Lightdash's JSON Schema for dbt YAML

`lightdash-dbt-2.0.json` is `packages/common/src/schemas/json/lightdash-dbt-2.0.json` of
[lightdash/lightdash](https://github.com/lightdash/lightdash) at commit
`1a72186cb4cbcd27ed81ff2dce248a88598e7727` (29 September 2026), the schema Lightdash publishes for
the `meta` of dbt model properties files. It is copied unchanged. The tests validate every
Lightdash export model2data writes against it (`tests/test_metrics_lightdash.py`).

It is licensed under the MIT License: see `LICENSE` beside it, copied from the same commit (the
MIT terms cover everything outside `packages/backend/src/ee`). It is test data only and is not
shipped in the model2data package.
